title: Ensure repository deletion is limited to specific users
description: A deleted repository takes its history, pull requests and policies with it. On Azure DevOps, "Delete or disable repository" is its own permission, held by default by Project Administrators — who also hold Manage permissions. This control fails when anyone who does not administer the repository holds it. Organization administrators can delete anything and are counted by CIS-1.3.3 instead.
remediation: Project settings -> Repositories -> <repository> -> Security, and the All Repositories level above it: set "Delete or disable repository" to Not set for everyone listed who does not also hold Manage permissions. For repositories that must not be lost, keep an independent mirror: an administrator's deletion cannot be prevented by configuration alone.
fixSummary: Remove "Delete or disable repository" at Project settings -> Repositories -> <repo> -> Security.
